data.name: Narpat
data.gender_notes: Narpat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Nar’, meaning man, and ‘Pat’, meaning lord. Narpat signifies the ruler or protector of men. The name Narpat carries the meaning “Lord of Men” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Narpat usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of men and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Narpat belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Men.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narpat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Narpat is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is believed to bring power, strength, and leadership qualities. It is prevalent in Indian literature, mythology, and royal lineages, highlighting the Hindu belief in the ruler as a protector and a guide to his people.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Narpat signifies the supreme presiding deity over the human life, the Lord Narayana, who is the protector and sustainer of all life forms. The name invokes the divine qualities of love, compassion, and wisdom, serving as a reminder of the moral and spiritual obligations of the individual towards themselves and others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Narpat signifies the supreme ruler of all beings, symbolizing the divine king within, who governs and protects the inner universe. This name invokes the strength and wisdom of Lord Narayana as a wise monarch, guiding one's inner journey towards enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Narpat was the name of a king in the 12th century in the Chalukya dynasty of Karnataka, India. The name Narpat carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Narpat continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Amit Narpat in Kolkata, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Narpat, which means "Lord of Men". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
